components.name: Play Disc
components.description: The primary transport action — a 56px green disc carrying the system's strongest glow.
components.html: <button class="ds-play-disc" aria-label="Play"><svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-play-disc { background: #22c55e; color: #ffffff; width: 56px; height: 56px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-play-disc:hover { background: #4ade80; } .ds-play-disc:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #000000, 0 0 0 4px #4ade80; } .ds-play-disc:active { background: #16a34a; }

components.name: Transport Button
components.description: Resting transport controls (Stop, Pause) — gray rack switches with a deliberate 4px sharpness.
components.css: .ds-transport-btn { background: #4b5563; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-transport-btn:hover { background: #6b7280; } .ds-transport-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #000000, 0 0 0 4px #4ade80; } .ds-transport-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Transport Button Live
components.description: The transport bar's Play button — the lamp is on: Power LED Green with near-black text.
components.css: .ds-transport-live { background: #22c55e; color: #000000; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-transport-live:hover { background: #4ade80; } .ds-transport-live:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #000000, 0 0 0 4px #4ade80; }

components.name: Loop Toggle Active
components.description: The Loop lamp in its active mode state — Transport Blue, distinct from playback green.
components.css: .ds-loop-active { background: #3b82f6; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-loop-active:hover { background: #60a5fa; } .ds-loop-active:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #000000, 0 0 0 4px #60a5fa; }

components.name: Record Button Armed
components.description: The recording lamp while armed — Record Red, breathing slowly. Disabled state is a dead lamp (gray-700 at half opacity).
components.css: .ds-record-armed { background: #ef4444; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; animation: ds-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite; } .ds-record-armed:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #000000, 0 0 0 4px #f87171; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.5; } }

components.name: Player Card

components.name: Meter Slider
components.description: The green-tuned slider primitive — gray-600 track, Power LED Green range, white disc thumb with a green ring.
components.css: .ds-slider { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 20px; } .ds-slider-track { position: relative; height: 8px; width: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: #4b5563; } .ds-slider-range { position: absolute; height: 8px; width: 60%; border-radius: 9999px; background: #22c55e; } .ds-slider-thumb { position: absolute; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); left: calc(60% - 10px); width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffffff; border: 2px solid #22c55e; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); cursor: grab; } .ds-slider-thumb:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #000000, 0 0 0 4px #4ade80; }

components.name: Meter Legend
components.description: The channel meter legend — cyan disc for Left, amber disc for Right, 14px labels. The Meter Pair Rule made visible.
components.html: Left ChannelRight Channel

narrative.overview:
Anahata's interface is a physical instrument viewed at night: a matte-black chassis whose surfaces are flat, tonal layers of graphite, with light reserved for what is alive. The interface recedes so the sound leads — quiet, unhurried, engineered, honest. Nothing on screen claims more attention than the signal it represents.

Depth is tonal, never theatrical: cards are darker or lighter strata of the chassis, sometimes translucent with a soft backdrop blur, and glow appears only where the user's attention should land — the play control, the player card, the slider thumb. The wordmark's green-to-blue gradient is the single expressive flourish; everything else earns its color by meaning something.

The system deliberately rejects the neon-purple "spiritual glow" aesthetic common to wellness apps. Anahata's honesty-over-hype voice extends to its visuals: the meters show the real signal, the lamps report real state, and ornament that claims nothing is left out.
keyCharacteristics: Matte-black instrument chassis — flat tonal surfaces, soft translucency, no general elevation
One lamp vocabulary: green = live transport, cyan/amber = the channel pair, red = recording
System type stack — hierarchy by size, weight, and tone, never by added fonts
A single gradient flourish (green to blue) on the wordmark and player-tile identity
The real-signal waveform canvas as the centerpiece: instrument output, not decoration

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Power LED Green marks live transport actions only — play, the active range, the thumb ring. If everything is green, nothing is.

rules.name: The Meter Pair Rule
rules.body: Left channel is cyan, right channel is amber — legend dots, traces, and labels agree everywhere they appear. Never swap them and never add a third channel color.

rules.name: The System Voice Rule
rules.body: No display webfonts, ever. If a hierarchy needs more force, add size, weight, or tone — not a new typeface.

rules.name: The Flat Chassis Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat at rest. Shadow appears only on the three focal points — play button, player card, slider thumb. Nowhere else, at any elevation.

dos: Do keep the chassis black/graphite — color arrives only through the lamp vocabulary.
Do use Power LED Green for live transport actions and the active slider range — the One Lamp Rule.
Do keep the cyan/amber meter pair for left/right channels everywhere both appear.
Do build text hierarchy from white to gray-300 to gray-400 tone steps, not new hues.
Do show the real signal in the visualizer — the trace is instrument output, never illustration.
donts: Don't introduce neon purple/violet "spiritual glow" wellness gradients into the app chrome; preset tiles keep their individual hues as content, not decoration.
Don't use shadows for general elevation — the Flat Chassis Rule reserves glow for the play button, player card, and slider thumb.
Don't add new accent hues to the chrome beyond the lamp set (green, blue, cyan, amber, red).
Don't set text below 12px, and never shrink the meter labels to fit — shorten the copy instead.
